A '''skirmish''' occurred in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] had earlier [[Second skirmish in the Outer Rim|captured]] the [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Urias Xhaxin]], who himself had [[Skirmish in the Outer Rim|tangled]] with the [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], a mysterious [[Alien/Legends|alien]] threat lurking in the Outer Rim. After pumping Xhaxin for information, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] had dispatched a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] to the site of Xhaxin's battle, but when the data proved inconclusive, he sent a [[T-65BR X-wing reconnaissance starfighter]] designated "[[Snoop]]" so that a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] could collect and analyze data.

Rogue Squadron escorted the reconnaissance fighter, and after arriving at the location, they engaged a group of waiting coralskippers. Having spent [[Time/Legends|time]] running [[Skipchaser|simulations]] against the fighters, the Rogues used innovative techniques to overcome the coralskippers' [[dovin basal]]s, which manipulated [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] to give them the edge in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. The Rogues destroyed all of their opponents but lost Rogues [[Rogue Eleven/Legends|Eleven]] and [[Rogue Twelve|Twelve]], [[Dinger]] and [[Tik (Rogue Squadron)|Tik]]. The first field test of the New Republic's anti-coralskipper strategies proved to be critical as the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] proceeded.
